prompt: Create a high-quality editorial photography and graphic design composition using the reference image. Feature a stylish young woman in a dynamic, playful pose, holding oversized props—bright red balloons against a vivid blue sky with mountains in the background, or an oversized orange megaphone against a textured green urban wall. Present the original photorealistic scene in the upper half and a creative experimental art direction version in the lower half. Overlay the lower image with seven clearly defined visual texture samples: reeded glass, black-and-white engraving, American stipple, vintage halftone, pixel mosaic, transparent overlays, and duotone screen printing. Add fine white annotation lines, small numbered labels, and rectangular sample frames to explain each effect. Preserve the subject’s pose, clothing, lighting, and composition. Use vibrant colors, cinematic natural lighting, detailed textures, contemporary Japanese editorial aesthetics, and a sophisticated art-school design layout. Ultra-realistic photography combined with experimental mixed-media graphics, crisp details, balanced composition, high resolution, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.

promptZh: 以参考图像为基础，创作一幅高品质的编辑类摄影与平面设计合成作品。画面主体为一位时尚年轻女性，姿态动感俏皮，手持超大号道具——可以是鲜艳蓝天下、远山映衬中的大红色气球，也可以是纹理丰富的绿色城市墙面前的一只巨型橙色扩音器。上半部分呈现原始的照片级写实场景，下半部分则展示富有创意的实验性艺术指导版本。在下半部分的图像上叠加七种清晰可辨的视觉纹理样本：竖纹玻璃、黑白雕版、美式点刻、复古半调、像素马赛克、透明叠层以及双色调丝网印刷。添加精细的白色标注线、小型数字标签和矩形样本框，以说明每种效果。保留人物的姿态、服装、光线与构图。采用明艳的色彩、电影感的自然光效、细腻的纹理质感，融入当代日式编辑美学与精致的艺术院校设计风格。超写实摄影与实验性混合媒介图形相结合，细节锐利，构图均衡，高分辨率，垂直 4:5 画幅比例。
